chunks: From them, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

A man asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) regarding the Statement of Allah, the Exalted and Mighty: 'For them is good news in the worldly life.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is the good vision which the believer sees, so he is given good news by it in his worldly life.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'good news in the worldly life' in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the 'good news in the worldly life' mentioned in Surah Yunus is identified as the truthful dream (ru'ya hasanah), which serves as a fragment of prophethood for the believer. This interpretation highlights the Shia theological view that dreams are a legitimate channel of divine communication and spiritual comfort, bridging the gap between the unseen and the believer's daily experience. It underscores the continuity of spiritual insight (kashf) in the post-Prophetic era through the faithful.
